# Project general coding standards

## Virtual environment
- Always activate and use the virtual environment `Code/venv` for development and testing.

## Python conventions
- Follow PEP 8 guidelines for whitespaces.
  - No line with just whitespaces.
  - A line cannot have trailing whitespaces.
  - Each file should end with a single newline character.
- No need to strictly adhere to the 79 characters per line limit; however, strive to keep lines reasonably short (<140) for better readability.
